note: Gate-checkable projection of the QA Checklist in ../../SKILL.md (authoritative). type=python checks are computable via genie_reference.py; type=manual require agent/render/source inspection. SKILL.md wins on any disagreement.

GATE_1_title_lock.text: Sub-type locked (REF-FACT/REF-TRIVIA/REF-LIST/REF-REF) with signal evidence; secondary sub-type (<25% pages) documented if present
Title count claim achievable within entry density and target page range for the sub-type
Trademark and competitive uniqueness screen run; conflicts noted before proceeding
Every superlative in title/concept flagged by tier (volatile/semi-stable/fixed)
Adult audience unambiguous; OV-CFACT/OV-CHILD re-route check clear
REF-TRIVIA: rounds x fixed questions-per-round consistent; total in target-question band; difficulty ladder positions valid
Target page count even and within KDP-supported range for the sub-type
Book Lock output complete; three subtitles generated and selection recorded; KDP category targets identified

GATE_2_manuscript_verification.text: Total verified entry count meets or exceeds the title count claim; no padding, no double-count
REF-FACT: every anchor and supporting-cluster fact carries a WHY note meeting adult-depth standard
REF-TRIVIA: every question has exactly one defensible answer; disputed resolved-with-note or removed; no unlisted-technicality traps
REF-LIST: ranking methodology note precedes list; stated criteria referenced by every entry
REF-REF: every lookup entry follows the locked template without deviation
Every entry has two independent authoritative sources on record; volatile records confirmed against source dated within 2 years
Superlative audit complete; volatile superlatives carry inline (as of [year]) date stamp in body text
Full duplicate-entry scan complete; no fact/question/entry appears twice; result recorded
REF-LIST: all entries within 20% of target word count (REF-REF: within 30%)
Front matter (title/copyright/TOC/introduction) and per-sub-type back matter (index/bibliography) complete

GATE_3_interior_design.text: Trim and page geometry match Book Lock; all pages at correct bleed dimensions
Type floors met on every page: body 10pt, questions 11pt, headers 14pt, sidebar/index 9pt; fonts embedded
All body/entry text left-aligned (not full-justified); headers styled consistently throughout
REF-TRIVIA: answers section visually distinct; no answer visible on any question page
Sidebars on no more than 40% of pages; all sidebars subordinate to main entry
Spot/full-color (if used) consistent and AA-passing; no critical info by color alone
Index alphabetical with hanging indent for sub-entries; folios and running headers correct and consistent

GATE_4_preflight_release.text: Final page count even and within KDP-supported range for the trim and ink mode
Verified count in final PDF equals or exceeds count claim
Superlative audit re-confirmed on final text; no undated volatile claim survives
Verification log complete, no entry UNVERIFIED; duplicate-scan and disputed-answer logs on file
Fixed-layout PDF at correct bleed on every page; all fonts embedded; real editable text; images >=300 DPI; AI-disclosure met
Physical proof reviewed; KDP category/keywords/description final; title count claim matches actual count
